title: Esculin alleviates LPS-induced acute lung injury via inhibiting neutrophil recruitment and migration.
authors: Ni, Jiangwei; Li, Ge; Dai, Ningfeng; Quan, Zijiao; Tong, Haibin; Liu, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Esculin对急性肺损伤中中性粒细胞迁移的抑制作用，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作（整合素与ICAM-1）及分子对接，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Acute lung injury (ALI) poses a serious threat to human health globally, particularly with the Coronavirus 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic. Excessive recruitment and infiltration of neutrophils is the major etiopathogenesis of ALI. Esculin, also known as 6,7-dihydroxycoumarin, is a remarkable compound derived from traditional Chinese medicine Cortex fraxini. Accumulated evidence indicates that esculin has potent anti-inflammatory effects, but its pharmaceutical effect against ALI and potential mechanisms are still unclear. METHODS: This study evaluated the protective effect of esculin against ALI by histopathological observation and biochemical analysis of lung tissues and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-challenged ALI mice in vivo. The effects of esculin on N-formyl-met-leu-phe (fMLP)-induced neutrophil migration and chemotaxis were quantitatively assessed using a Transwell assay and an automated cell imaging system equipped with a Zigmond chamber, respectively. The drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) assay, in vitro protein binding assay and molecular docking were performed to identify the potential therapeutic target of esculin and the potential binding sites and pattern. RESULTS: Esculin significantly attenuated LPS-induced lung pathological injury, reduced the levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines in both BALF and lung, and suppressed the activation of NF-kappaB signaling. Esculin also significantly reduced the number of total cells and neutrophils as well as myeloperoxidase (MPO) activity in the BALF. Esculin impaired neutrophil migration and chemotaxis as evidenced by the reduced migration distance and velocity. Furthermore, esculin remarkably inhibited Vav1 phosphorylation, suppressed Rac1 activation and the PAK1/LIMK1/cofilin signaling axis. Mechanistically, esculin could interact with beta(2) integrin and then diminish its ligand affinity with intercellular adhesion molecule-1 (ICAM-1). CONCLUSIONS: Esculin inhibits beta(2) integrin-dependent neutrophil migration and chemotaxis, blocks the cytoskeletal remodeling process required for neutrophil recruitment, thereby contributing to its protective effect against ALI. This study demonstrates the new therapeutic potential of esculin as a novel lead compound.
abstract_zh: 目的：急性肺损伤（ALI）对全球人类健康构成严重威胁，尤其是在2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行背景下。中性粒细胞的过度募集和浸润是ALI的主要病因。秦皮乙素（Esculin），又称6,7-二羟基香豆素，是一种源自中药秦皮（Cortex fraxini）的显著化合物。累积证据表明，秦皮乙素具有强效抗炎作用，但其对ALI的药效及潜在机制仍不清楚。方法：本研究通过组织病理学观察和肺组织及支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）的生化分析，在体内评估了秦皮乙素对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的ALI小鼠的保护作用。分别使用Transwell实验和配备Zigmond小室的自动细胞成像系统，定量评估了秦皮乙素对N-甲酰基-甲硫氨酰-亮氨酰-苯丙氨酸（fMLP）诱导的中性粒细胞迁移和趋化的影响。采用药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）实验、体外蛋白结合实验和分子对接，以鉴定秦皮乙素的潜在治疗靶点及其潜在结合位点和模式。结果：秦皮乙素显著减轻了LPS诱导的肺病理损伤，降低了BALF和肺组织中促炎细胞因子的水平，并抑制了NF-κB信号通路的激活。秦皮乙素还显著减少了BALF中总细胞和中性粒细胞的数量以及髓过氧化物酶（MPO）活性。秦皮乙素损害了中性粒细胞的迁移和趋化，表现为迁移距离和速度的降低。此外，秦皮乙素显著抑制了Vav1磷酸化，阻断了Rac1激活及PAK1/LIMK1/cofilin信号轴。机制上，秦皮乙素可与β(2)整合素相互作用，并降低其与细胞间黏附分子-1（ICAM-1）的配体亲和力。结论：秦皮乙素抑制β(2)整合素依赖性中性粒细胞迁移和趋化，阻断中性粒细胞募集所需的细胞骨架重塑过程，从而发挥其对ALI的保护作用。本研究展示了秦皮乙素作为新型先导化合物的新治疗潜力。
